summary: Frontend-only verification of dark-mode contrast fix in EmailTemplatesEditor (Configuración > Plantillas de Correo Electrónico). Validated computed styles for the two accordion headers 'Plantillas Personalizadas' (data-testid=tpl-section-toggle-custom) and 'Plantillas de Proyecto (Implementación)' (data-testid=tpl-section-toggle-project) as well as their expanded bodies. Also verified no regression in LIGHT mode.

verification_details.dark_mode_html_class: html.dark = true (after clicking theme-toggle-button; label switched 'Modo oscuro' -> 'Modo claro')

custom_header_DARK.bgImage: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(76,29,149,0.3), rgba(112,26,117,0.3))  // violet-900/30 -> fuchsia-900/30
custom_header_DARK.verdict: OK - dark tinted violet/fuchsia background with legible light title & counter

project_header_DARK.bgImage: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(124,45,18,0.3), rgba(19,78,74,0.3))  // orange-900/30 -> teal-900/30
project_header_DARK.verdict: OK - dark tinted orange/teal background with legible light title & counter

custom_body_DARK.textColor: rgb(159,171,188)  // legible slate-400 on dark tint

critical_code_review_comments: EmailTemplatesEditor.jsx is 1542 lines; consider splitting per section (custom/sede/project) into sub-components for maintainability.

Inner cards inside expanded sections still use hardcoded 'bg-white text-slate-900 border-violet-200/orange-200' without explicit dark: variants; they only look OK because global .dark overrides flip text-slate-900 to light and bg-white to dark. Recommend adding explicit dark: variants for robustness against future global-override refactors.
'Plantillas Sede Pyme' and 'Plantillas Sede Corp' headers use 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200' with no dark: variants either; they currently look fine only via global overrides. Same recommendation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark-mode contrast fix for 'Plantillas Personalizadas' and 'Plantillas de Proyecto (Implementación)' accordions in EmailTemplatesEditor validated via computed styles + visual screenshots. Both headers now show dark violet/fuchsia and orange/teal tints with legible light text and counters. Light-mode gradients preserved. To reach the screen: login admin -> Enter to dismiss pending-messages overlay -> click theme-toggle-button (once) to enable dark -> Configuración (sidebar) -> click 'Plantillas de Correo' tab. Toggles: tpl-section-toggle-custom / tpl-section-toggle-project.
